description: Top-level orchestrator that ties all five CEN modules together for a single family case. Handles intake, triage, parallel and sequential module invocation, shared case state, supervisor escalation, KPI rollup, and unified closure.

metadata.label: Case Create
metadata.description: Generate case ID, capture referral source, assign Latimer Leader and CEN team by ZIP.

metadata.label: Master HIPAA, AOR, & Advocacy Consent
metadata.description: Single signed consent covering all downstream modules.

metadata.label: Initialize Shared Case Object
metadata.description: Create canonical patient/household/financial/clinical record consumed by all modules.

metadata.label: Triage Intake
metadata.description: Capture presenting issues: bills, denials, uninsured, SDOH, legal.

metadata.label: Triage Classifier
metadata.description: LLM + rules engine determines which modules to invoke and in what order.

metadata.label: Invoke Charity Care Navigator
metadata.description: Sub-DAG: charity_care_navigator v2.0

metadata.label: Invoke Debt Cancellation Engine
metadata.description: Sub-DAG: debt_cancellation_engine v2.0

metadata.label: Invoke Insurance Appeal Assistant
metadata.description: Sub-DAG: insurance_appeal_assistant v2.0

metadata.label: Invoke Benefits Enrollment Navigator
metadata.description: Sub-DAG: benefits_enrollment_navigator v2.0

metadata.label: Invoke Community Resource Router
metadata.description: Sub-DAG: community_resource_router v2.0

metadata.label: Module Status Aggregator
metadata.description: Collect status, outcomes, and exceptions from each invoked sub-DAG.

metadata.label: Cross-Module Dependencies Resolved?
metadata.description: Example: charity care denial triggers debt engine; uninsured triggers benefits then charity care.

metadata.label: Module Wait State
metadata.description: Pause orchestrator until pending module SLAs return.

metadata.label: Supervisor Escalation Queue
metadata.description: Route to CEN supervisor or Guild specialist for manual review.

metadata.label: KPI Rollup
metadata.description: Aggregate dollars saved, applications approved, appeals overturned, services connected, hours saved.

metadata.label: Family Summary Generation
metadata.description: Generate plain-language summary of all outcomes in preferred language.

metadata.label: Unified Patient Notification
metadata.description: Single SMS, email, voice, and printed letter covering all modules.

metadata.label: Follow-Up Scheduler
metadata.description: 30/60/90 day check-ins, redetermination dates, re-screening.

metadata.label: Latimer Leader Mentoring Credit
metadata.description: Tag case to Latimer Leader's training portfolio.

metadata.label: Master Case Close
metadata.description: Close case with reason code RESOLVED, PARTIAL, or ESCALATED.
